Before being evaluated against a master tuning, the current tuning will be adjusted so that the difference between it and the master tuning averges to zero in this chosen octave
When you are satisfied that the desired temperament octave has been selected, tap below to select the master tuning that will be used to evaluate the current tuning
Tap in the space above to enter your license number then tap on "Save"

This page is only for those who cannot use the 'forever license' because their device does not connect to the Internet to verify the license. For all others, go back to the previous page and enter your 'forever license' there.\10\10The legacy license is based on the ID shown below.  This ID changes with each device, and when a device is factory-reset.  Therefore if you use the legacy licensing method you will need to send in this ID if the ID changes or you get a new device.
